description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the 'contextual' module, including toolbar, page attachments, help, and view alter hooks.

classes.name: Drupal\contextual\Hook\ContextualHooks
classes.description: Contains hook implementations for the contextual module, including toolbar, page attachments, help, and view alter hooks.

methods.name: toolbar
methods.description: Provides a toolbar item for editing contextual links if the user has permission.

methods.name: pageAttachments
methods.description: Attaches the contextual links library to the page if the user has permission.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help content for the contextual module, including description and usage instructions.

methods.name: contextualLinksViewAlter
methods.description: Alters the view to decode and set contextual links from encoded data.
